items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from hamstring; was listed Q.
items.why: Full practice week, starter reps, medical clearance path.
items.implication: Bears offense upgrade; Levitan views Q tag as more probable.
items.opportunity: Full QB1 workload return boosts CHI pass-catchers.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to a blood clot; out for the foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot consultations with doctors led to IR placement Saturday.
items.implication: McKee starts; PHI pass-catchers retain top-4 health but RB thin with Barkley/Shipley also out.
items.opportunity: Increased reliance on DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks in passing game.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after IR stint for high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Activated from IR; practiced this week.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 upside in return; Berry starting as WR2 if active.
items.opportunity: Primary target share return vs Jets secondary.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley.
items.why: Hamstring; ruled out on Friday report.
items.implication: PHI RB room down to 4th-string Dameon Pierce; thin backfield with McKee at QB.
items.opportunity: Any remaining RBs or pass-catcher checkdowns elevated.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play vs Browns.
items.implication: Depth WR option with Lamar out.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee anywhere needing QB; will be better than thought. Not worried about Eagles skill players with him. Start AJ Brown if active as WR2.
items.why: McKee can play; top pass-catchers healthy; AJB return.
items.implication: Stream McKee; lock in PHI WRs/AJB.
items.opportunity: PHI pass volume to healthy weapons.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle Qs more like probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice participation and report nuances; PIT depth chart thinness; PHI skill health.
items.implication: Probable players safer starts; Metcalf heavy usage; PHI pass-catchers viable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf route/target concentration; PHI WR/TE snaps secure.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: Huntley starts again; Ravens pass game limited.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers still viable but Andrews/Likely volume shifts possible; Ja'Kobi Lane activated.
Xavier Worthy and others elevated target share.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT along with AD Mitchell.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and soft run defense matchup.
items.why: Volume elite lately; ARI leaks vs run.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB situation.
